name: Auto Decorate
description: Select blocks in the editor, pick a style (this level, an online level or a player's level) and Auto Decorate adds clean, flowing decoration along the exposed edges.

open-menu-key.name: Open Auto Decorate Menu
open-menu-key.description: Opens the Auto Decorate menu while you are in the editor.

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Run
max-objects.description: Safety limit: Auto Decorate stops after placing this many objects in one run.
